projects.title: Coupling Quantization in Oscillator-Based Ising Machines
projects.summary: Studying how hardware non-idealities affect oscillator-based Ising machines that solve Max-Cut and other NP-hard problems.
bullets: Developing a C++/Qt simulation and analysis tool to evaluate coupling quantization, hardware mismatch, and optimization performance.
Built a Monte Carlo framework comparing ideal and quantized coupling matrices across 10,000 trials, cutting analysis time by 22%.
Assisting with experimental verification of an Ising machine chip for multi-user MIMO (MU-MIMO) detection using oscilloscope measurements and lab test setups.
